content.title: Full 2026 March Madness schedule unveiled
content.text: Full schedule from Selection Sunday to title game The 2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament schedule begins with Selection Sunday at 6 p.m. ET on March 15, airing on CBS. The First Four is set for March 17-18, followed by the first round on March 19-20 and second round on March 21-22. The Sweet 16 will be played March 26-27, the Elite Eight on March 28-29, the Final Four on April 4, and the championship game on April 6 at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, broadcast on TBS. Heavy + 1 Tournament venues span four time zones The First Four will be hosted in Dayton, Ohio, at UD Arena. First- and second-round games will be played in Buffalo, NY; Greenville, SC; Oklahoma City, OK; Portland, OR; Tampa, FL; Philadelphia, PA; San Diego, CA; and St. Louis, MO. Sweet 16 and Elite Eight matchups will be held at designated regional sites before the Final Four in Indianapolis. sportshistori.com + 1 Host cities and arenas for early rounds Buffalo’s KeyBank Center, Greenville’s Bon Secours Wellness Arena, Oklahoma City’s Paycom Center, and Portland’s Moda Center will host first-round games on March 19. Tampa’s Benchmark International Arena, Philadelphia’s Xfinity Mobile Arena, San Diego’s Viejas Arena, and St. Louis’ Enterprise Center will host on March 20. These venues will also stage second-round games on March 21-22. Heavy + 1 Indianapolis to host Final Four and championship Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis will be the stage for the Final Four on April 4, with games scheduled for 6 p.m. and 8:30 p.m. ET. The NCAA championship game will follow on April 6 at 8:30 p.m. ET. This marks another high-profile basketball event for the city, a frequent host of NCAA tournament finales. Heavy + 1 3 references
